articles.title: Live markets: Bitcoin falls back to $59,000 as Strategy's common and preferred stocks tumble
articles.snippet: Trading firm Wintermute's options desk puts bitcoin in a $61,242 to $63,563 range for Tuesday, with correlation rising across tokens and no fresh ETF bid in sight.

articles.title: South Korea adds token securities to capital market overhaul
articles.snippet: South Korea’s Financial Services Commission has placed token securities infrastructure within a wider capital-market modernization plan covering faster settlement, longer trading hours and digital transformation.

articles.title: CFTC sues Kentucky after state’s prediction market lawsuits
articles.snippet: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission has sued Kentucky, now the ninth state the regulator is battling in its fight over prediction markets.

articles.title: Trump Orders Acceleration of Quantum Readiness as Bitcoin Faces Coming Risk
articles.snippet: President Donald Trump signed two executive orders aimed at expanding U.S. quantum computing capabilities and speeding the transition to quantum-resistant encryption.

articles.title: Ethereum MEV Bot JaredFromSubway Threatens Legal Action After $7.5 Million Loss
articles.snippet: The well-known trading bot took a hit this weekend after it fell victim to a series of transactions that left its logic exposed.
